result: The proposed profile is closed under complete joins and disjoint unions, yielding the exact restricted profile for all weighted cographs and their limits. High-density disjoint unions have an explicit positive gap.
gap: General non-cograph hosts are not reduced to the recursive class; no almost-P4-free theorem is assumed.
planned_final_direction: Optimize the distinct rank-one latent-product kernel family through moment inequalities.
